name: Can I paint over existing cabinet finishes, or do they need to be stripped?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint over existing cabinet finishes, or do they need to be stripped?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cases, you can paint over existing cabinet finishes without stripping them entirely, provided the current finish is in good condition and properly prepared. This involves thoroughly cleaning, degreasing, sanding to dull the surface, and applying a high-quality primer. Stripping is typically only necessary if the existing finish is peeling, heavily damaged, or incompatible with the new paint. A professional assessment by Frasheski Construction can determine the most efficient and effective approach for your specific cabinets, ensuring optimal adhesion and a lasting result.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can often paint over existing finishes if they are in good condition and properly prepared. Stripping is usually only needed for damaged or incompatible finishes.
